decision.why: Establish image scope, grouping and integrity before interpreting baseline failures or assigning a small experiment.
decision.hypothesis: Dataset structure and image quality may reveal constraints that determine which recognition failure is useful to test first.
decision.expected_observation: An inventory of the 32 excerpts and seven song groups, integrity findings, and available metadata relevant to melody, chord timing and transposition.

observation.label_policy: Recognition sees images only. References are opened by evaluation.
observation.release_limits: Conservative completion guard for this prototype, not a musician-agreed product release threshold. A seven-sample pilot cannot complete this goal. Report measured improvements separately.

model_metadata.context_isolation: fresh temporary directory outside the project; only explicit prompt, schema and optional image
model_metadata.billing: Uses existing Codex account; monetary cost unavailable
